about.body: Frontend Engineer with 7 years of experience specializing in React. Experienced in leading frontend teams on complex projects, including a comprehensive Laboratory and Biobank Management Platform, the Evano (MCI) Gift Card application, as well as e-commerce and e-learning websites. Focused on building scalable application architectures, writing clean and maintainable code, and collaborating closely with backend engineers and design teams to deliver high-quality products.
